quest.title: May the Moonlight Connect Us
quest.description: A small animal seems to be in trouble at the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm? What are you looking at, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that a... Chic Badger?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, what's he doing here all alone? Is he looking for The Damselette?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It kinda seems like something scared him. C'mon, let's bring him inside with us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Zzz... Zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, she seems to be taking an afternoon nap. Guess we'll come back later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, wait! Don't go over there—

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: ...Mmph!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ouch...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah, you slipped? Don't worry, I'm not hurt. Hm? Oh, you two are here as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess a Moon Goddess isn't immune to a few bumps and bruises...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I don't mind little critters bumping into me, so long as the kuuvahki emanating from them reflects no ill-intent.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Did something happen? Why are you so afraid, little one?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hm, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, so you can understand these animals too?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The moon shines high over Nod-Krai. All animals that grow beneath the light of kuuvahki can be considered "familiars of the Moon Goddess."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what did this little guy say?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: That monsters have appeared where he lives. He was looking for Lauma, but the monsters chased him to this area...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh... No wonder he's so scared...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where should we take him?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Back to Lauma, I think. She will know how to handle this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, looks like it's another trip out for us. Since we're heading to the Frostmoon Scions, make sure you hide extra good this time!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Good idea. I'll ask Kunegunda to bring more fruit over later. She will need rest over the next two days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like Lauma's busy right now. Let's give her a moment.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I realized, many years ago, that the Moonchanter is a figure of great importance to the Frostmoon Scions.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I think their task is even harder than that of a god.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally! She's got some free time. Let's—

dialogues.speaker: Vanamo
dialogues.text: My lady, some of the defensive structures over here require your attention.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Of course. I'll see to that right away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And off she goes again! She never gets a moment's rest, does she?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's follow them. But, keep it quiet!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...This will do. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Come night or day, may the moonlight connect us.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: ...Hmm? That saying has changed from when I last heard it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! That person left. C'mon, now's our chance!

dialogues.speaker: Maciej
dialogues.text: Lady Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously!?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Thank you for your hard work. Excuse me for a moment. I will be back shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: There is no one around. You can come out now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you knew we were here!?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: How could I possibly miss the "Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar" and her kuuvahki?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Although... I'm not quite sure why you're following me. It's quite unnerving... being "observed" at work like this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, um... S—Sorry about that. We wanted to ask you about something, but the time was never right... Hopefully, we didn't stress you out too much...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Ah, I see... Understood. I'll handle it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To be honest, after seeing how busy you are, Paimon kinda feels bad asking you to do more work...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Ah, it's nothing. Such is the duty of the Moonchanter.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Now that you have seen all this, "Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar", what do you think of the Frostmoon Scions today?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The atmosphere is much changed from how it was several centuries ago. It's a good kind of change.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I'm glad to hear it... And I thank you for your kind words.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Give me your hand.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: #You too, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Oh, um... Why?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I like the current prayer you use around here.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: ...Come night or day, may the moonlight connect us.
